title: Silver Price Comparison: Troy Ounce vs. Regular Ounce
narration: This chart illustrates the significant price difference between silver sold in troy ounces and regular ounces. As of October 26, 2023, a troy ounce costs $30.00, while a regular ounce is priced at $27.00. This difference becomes even more pronounced when purchasing larger quantities, highlighting the importance of verifying the unit of weight before making a purchase. Understanding this distinction can save you considerable money.
